hero.title:
Modern essentials.
Considered deeply.
hero.body: Everyday pieces cut from natural materials in small runs, made to be worn well past the season.
hero.alt: Knitwear, a brown wool coat and linen trousers on a pale wooden rail in soft morning light

piece.body: Double-faced Italian wool from our mill in Biella, unlined and hand-finished. Cut long through the body with a dropped shoulder, so it layers over knitwear without bulk.
piece.note: Free shipping over $150 · Thirty days to return unworn pieces

materials.title: Considered materials
materials.body: Wool, linen and vegetable-tanned leather chosen for how they wear over years, not seasons.

lasting.title: Made to last
lasting.body: Small production runs with named partners in Portugal and Italy, repeated only when they earn it.

fit.title: Fit, resolved
fit.body: Every piece is graded on real bodies before it reaches the collection.

bestPart.body: From everyday essentials to considered outerwear, each piece is cut from natural fibres and made in small runs. Wear it this season and the next.
bestPart.alt: Garments on a rail in a bare concrete studio

knit.title: Knitwear for the cold months
knit.body: Lambswool and merino spun in Biella, knitted in Portugal in ribs and half-gauges we repeat each season. Cut generous through the body so a shirt sits underneath.
knit.altA: Folded knit sweaters stacked beside a ball of yarn
knit.altB: Gold rings resting on a cream knit sleeve

shirt.title: Shirting, cut once and kept
shirt.body: Dry Italian cotton twill and washed poplin, boxy through the body with a squared hem. Two collars, four colourways, no seasonal variation.

collections.body: Four edits from the studio, each built from the same short list of fabrics we return to every season.
collections.altA: Denim jacket worn against a ribbed metal shutter

essentials.title: Everyday Essentials
essentials.description: The pieces we make every season: heavy tees, wide trousers and rib knits, in the fabrics we keep coming back to.

statement.title: Statement Pieces
statement.description: A short run of larger silhouettes: the wool coat, the overshirt, the weekender.

classics.title: The Classics
classics.description: Shirts, trousers and knits we have kept in the line since the early seasons, barely changed.

seasonal.title: Seasonal Collections
seasonal.description: Autumn and spring drops, released in small numbers and rarely repeated.
